text:
You need a proof-of-concept chatbot that feels human, verifies a patient’s identity, checks appointment availability from a simple database, books the slot, and sends an SMS confirmation.

I can build this with GPT-3-style conversation flow plus the appointment logic needed for a smooth booking experience. With 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas, I focus on turning a scripted business process into a reliable assistant that can guide the user step by step, collect the required details, and trigger the right actions at the right time.

A relevant example is my Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. One result was that 43% of conversations were resolved without an agent. That project is close to your use case because it required agent orchestration, tool calling, and a conversational flow that could move from natural language into a real operational action.

I also built a Contract clause search assistant for a confidential legal client using Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI. It answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. One result was improving clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That experience is useful here because your chatbot needs dependable retrieval and precise responses, especially when confirming patient identity, availability, and booking details.

For your POC, I would structure the assistant so it can:
- greet the user naturally
- verify ID and birthdate
- identify the doctor or clinic
- check available slots
- confirm the selected appointment
- send an SMS confirmation

If you’d like, I can also keep the conversational wording close to your sample flow while making sure the backend booking steps are clean and extensible.

Would you like this POC built as a simple web app first, or as a WhatsApp/SMS workflow from the start?
